newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Trading on Dhaka bourse resumes, buyers return.
newsitem.headline: Trading on Dhaka bourse resumes, buyers return.

text.p: Trading on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) resumed following a two-day suspension, and brokers said the market was regaining investors' confidence.
Brokers said most stocks in the engineering and leather counters gained in early trade with support from the state-owned Investment Corporation of Bangladesh (ICB).

"Market sentiment seems strong again. Buyers are regaining confidence," said one broker. Olympic Industries rose 116 to 2,429 and Bata Shoe rose 12 to 260. The DSE all share price index closed 48.8 points or 1.83 percent down at 2,618.3 on Saturday. --Dhaka Newsroom +880-2-50636
